testcase.name: all numeric limits are validated including inactive mode settings
rest time does not increase focused time
timer and phase deadline use elapsed clock despite wall clock edits
successful completion records exact planned focus rather than late alarm time
default pomodoro includes final long break and one hundred focused minutes
single session ignores configured pomodoro round count
reboot interruption preserves only checkpoint focus and checkpoint end time
boot count change and elapsed rollback are detected
default last long break remains active until its complete deadline
custom long break interval applies at each cycle boundary
exact boundaries enter next phase without a duplicated focus second
a final round outside the long break interval ends after focus
exit countdown is exactly sixty elapsed seconds and never negative
elapsed values clamp to valid session range
